items.name: Wolfsbane Sachet
items.lore: Dried wolfsbane in a linen bag. Werewolves will not come near it.

items.name: Moonbound Ring
items.lore: Silver, of course. It grows warm near the full moon.

items.name: Warder's Fang Bracer
items.lore: A werewolf warder's fangs, set in leather.

items.name: Cub's Blanket Cloak
items.lore: A child's blanket, let out into a cloak. Small hands mended it.

items.name: Sidhe Brooch
items.lore: Hibernian silver, worked in a knot that never ends.

items.name: Niamh's Token
items.lore: A pendant of green glass, warm as a hand.

items.name: Scout's Grey Cloak
items.lore: Grey as Skona fog. A scout can lie still in it for a day.

items.name: Spymaster's Ring
items.lore: The jarl's spymasters wear these. Thorvald gave you his.
